tools.title: Copilot Chat
tools.bestFor: Drafting, summarizing and brainstorming with information you supply
tools.description: Use the Microsoft Copilot app with a work or school account. Availability and the information Chat can reach depend on the tenant and the context in which it is open.
tools.access: Eligible work or school account; check your tenant
tools.where: Microsoft Copilot app (work account), if enabled
tools.gcc: Available in GCC; check your tenant rollout

tools.title: Microsoft 365 Copilot
tools.bestFor: Work-grounded help in eligible Microsoft 365 apps
tools.description: The paid Microsoft 365 Copilot product uses work information the signed-in person can already access. The Microsoft Copilot app is an interface, not a new name for the product or license.
tools.access: Microsoft 365 Copilot license and tenant enablement
tools.where: Eligible Microsoft 365 apps and Microsoft Copilot app (work account)
tools.gcc: Available in GCC; check your tenant rollout

tools.title: Researcher
tools.description: Researcher can synthesize complex questions from authorized work and web sources. Review the sources, findings and any generated citations.
tools.access: Microsoft 365 Copilot license; check your tenant
tools.where: Agents in the Microsoft Copilot app (work account), if enabled

tools.title: Analyst
tools.bestFor: Analysis of uploaded data and authorized work files
tools.description: Analyst helps inspect data, explain patterns and create analyses. Check the source data and calculations before relying on its conclusions.
tools.access: Microsoft 365 Copilot license; check your tenant
tools.where: Agents in the Microsoft Copilot app (work account), if enabled

tools.title: Copilot Cowork
tools.bestFor: Multistep work across Microsoft 365 with actions you review
tools.description: Describe an outcome and review the plan, sources and actions as Cowork works across Microsoft 365.
tools.access: Microsoft 365 Copilot license, with usage-based billing and Cowork billing both enabled for your tenant. The built-in App skill additionally requires Frontier program access.
tools.where: Microsoft Copilot app (work account), in Outlook and Teams, if enabled
tools.gcc: Commercial availability only as of this writing - Microsoft's own Cowork documentation makes no GCC availability statement. Confirm current GCC status with Microsoft before relying on Cowork in a GCC tenant.

tools.title: Copilot Studio
tools.description: Create agents with approved knowledge, topics and actions. Check the environment, security review, billing and cloud-specific features before sharing.
tools.access: Capacity and consumption vary; check your tenant
tools.where: Copilot Studio portal in your cloud
tools.gcc: Available in GCC with feature differences; check your tenant

tools.title: SharePoint agents
tools.bestFor: Answers grounded in approved SharePoint content
tools.description: Start from a site or library you can access. Sharing an agent does not grant people access to its source content; check the permissions and review path.
tools.access: Check your tenant and any capacity requirements
tools.where: Authorized SharePoint site or document library, if enabled

tools.title: Microsoft Foundry
tools.description: Microsoft Foundry serves Azure AI development, not the Microsoft 365 Copilot license. Azure Government and Microsoft 365 GCC are different clouds; verify your cloud's portal and supported services.
tools.access: Azure resources and consumption; check your cloud
tools.gcc: Check your tenant; Azure Government is not GCC

tools.title: GitHub Copilot
tools.description: GitHub Copilot is a separate product for supported developer workflows. Entitlements and organization policies are independent of Microsoft 365 Copilot.
tools.access: Separate organization plan or seat; check your tenant
tools.where: Supported IDE or GitHub, if enabled
